channel.title: Nation of Change - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: The fight to keep ICE from reopening a notorious prison
item.description: Survivors of abuse at a shuttered federal prison known as “the rape club” are teaming up with local activists to keep ICE out of Northern California.

item.title: Immigrants who say their detention is illegal have filed more than 18,000 cases. It’s a historic high.
item.description: The number of immigrants held in detention has increased from around 40,000 when Trump took office to more than 70,000 this year.

item.title: FAA shuts down El Paso airspace for 10 days, cites national defense without explanation
item.description: Federal officials provide no clear justification for unprecedented airspace closure affecting nearly 700,000 residents in major border city.

item.title: Senate GOP blocks effort to overturn $10.3 billion corporate tax break tied to IRS notice
item.description: Resolution targeting Trump administration guidance on corporate minimum tax fails 51-47 as advocates warn of expanded loopholes.
